YouTube Online Video Editor — initial release

- Instantly edit and export YouTube-ready videos with simple text prompts, no complex software required.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB, with cloud-based GPU processing.
- Seamless setup: auto-generates tokens for new users and handles session management.
- Export 1080p MP4 ready for YouTube in 1-2 minutes; batch editing and iterative workflows supported.
- Includes clear error handling, API integration, and keyword-based prompt routing for common editing actions.
